title: Help me find the best vibe coded game on steam !!!
author: Square_Reason_6490
selftext: I keep seeing amazing vibe coded prototypes, but where are the genuinely good finished games? By “vibe coded” I mean games where the developer relied heavily on AI to write and iterate on the code instead of coding most of it traditionally. What’s the best vibe coded game you’ve found that’s actually available on Steam and worth playing? No self promotion. I want games you discovered and would genuinely recommend. And if you know, how much of it was AI generated? Just the code, code + art, or basically the entire game? Whats the game that made you think, “Okay this is actually a damn good game?
